message.content:
There is an application log at /tmp/td/logs/app.log.

Your task: find all ERROR lines, count how many times each distinct error type/message occurs, and write a summary to /tmp/td/logs/summary.md listing the error types sorted by frequency (most frequent first), with counts.

Use standard command-line tools (grep, awk, sort, uniq) for the extraction and counting.

Constraints:
- Work ONLY inside /tmp/td/logs. Do not modify app.log.
- Produce /tmp/td/logs/summary.md.

Report which error was most frequent and its count.

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. content.text: The error type is the first token after ERROR. Let me extract and count by error type.

input.description: Extract and count error types by frequency

input.command:
{
  echo "# Error Summary"
  echo
  echo "Source: app.log"
  echo
  echo "| Count | Error type |"
  echo "|-------|------------|"
  grep "ERROR" /tmp/td/logs/app.log | awk '{print $3}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | \
    awk '{printf "| %s | %s |\n", $1, $2}'
} > /tmp/td/logs/summary.md
cat /tmp/td/logs/summary.md

content.text:
Done. I extracted all ERROR lines from `/tmp/td/logs/app.log` using grep/awk/sort/uniq and wrote the frequency-sorted summary to `/tmp/td/logs/summary.md`. The original log was not modified.

Most frequent error: DatabaseTimeout, with 3 occurrences (NullPointer: 1).

There were 4 ERROR lines total. Note: I grouped by error type (the token immediately after ERROR), so the three DatabaseTimeout lines — which had different trailing details ("on query users", "on connect", "on commit") — are counted together as one type.
